whatItIs.statement: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

whenToUse.statement: Use Breadcrumb when users need to understand or navigate the hierarchy leading to the current resource.

howToUse.statement: Compose Breadcrumb with BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, separators between items, and one BreadcrumbPage for the current page.
Use BreadcrumbLink asChild when the product routing library provides its own link component.

options.statement: Pass children to BreadcrumbSeparator to replace the default separator.
Use BreadcrumbEllipsis for a collapsed middle section when the breadcrumb path is too long.
